meta.title: Training Tower Inspections | Annual Facility Inspection & Maintenance
meta.description: TZJ annual inspection service for training towers and burn rooms — structural, burn room, and liner inspection by professional engineers with documented reports aligned with live-fire training facility standards.

hero.title: Annual Inspection Service
hero.description: Regular inspection of structure, burn rooms, and liner with professional reports — keeping every live-fire drill safe.

scheduleSection.title: How often should you inspect?
scheduleSection.description: Based on live-fire training facility standards and engineering experience, we recommend periodic assessment by professionals with live-fire structure experience — documented in writing.
scheduleSection.footnote: * Suggested intervals are reference only. Actual frequency should consider usage intensity, local requirements, and facility condition. We inspect metal, concrete, masonry, and container structures.

reviewSection.title: Critical areas we inspect
reviewSection.description: From structural shell to thermal liner — every critical area covered, no potential hazard overlooked.

categories.title: Doors, Windows & Hardware
categories.desc: Visual inspection of doors, windows, hinges, closers, latches, and hardware for wear and function.

categories.title: Structure & Building Envelope
categories.desc: Inspection of wall panels, roof panels, structural members, and overall envelope for wear, damage, and displacement.

categories.title: Egress & Life Safety
categories.desc: Inspection of stairs, guardrails, ladders, and hatches including visible treads, sprinklers, and piping.

categories.title: Panels & Fastening Systems
categories.desc: Inspection of thermal panels, panel positions, and fasteners; selective panel removal to inspect structure behind when needed.

categories.title: Seals & Connections
categories.desc: Inspection of caulking, fasteners, and connections; sampling of installation quality and seal integrity.

categories.title: Inspection Report
categories.desc: Illustrated report listing each finding with maintenance recommendations.

why.title: Ensure Safety
why.desc: Training facilities endure repeated heat and mechanical loads — regular inspection finds hazards early and reduces risk.

why.title: Extend Service Life
why.desc: Timely maintenance and local replacement significantly extend structure and liner life — protecting your investment.

why.title: Compliance & Traceability
why.desc: Inspection reports provide documented basis for compliant operation and facility management.
